Here is the small rp paragraph for an overview of my land trade for the island of Virginia (and the other island(s))

After the reformation of the army, Queen Verónica would set her sights on the fractured settlements of the island of Virginia. The island was mostly occupied with independent port city-states, with a consolidated settlement called the Virginia Free State on the eastern tip. Queen Verónica would offer the city-states a simple choice, either join the kingdom and gain land on the island of Virginia as well as become a county in a new state, or the Lavian army would occupy the city and agree with the proposal anyway. Naturally, most of the city-states accepted this deal, with the exception of the Virginia Free State and two other city-states that consolidated with them to form the country of the Virginia Free States. This would lead to a war lasting a year and six months. The two city-states would capitulate quickly, with the Virginia Free State offering up the only real resistance. Although Lavia experienced light casualties, the navy bombarding the ports of Virginia would cause a small famine which resulted in civil unrest and a quicker capitulation. With nearly all of their country conquered, the Virginia Free States would finally capitulate and become a county. The Queen was surprisingly lenient with the conquered government, allowing most of the leaders to become mayors or occupy low level government jobs.
